name: Rick Jarow
reason: No live own site: his domain rickjarow.org did not respond on 6 Nov 2026, and the only copy found (rickjarow-org.pages.dev, a static snapshot whose blog stops in June 2020) lists workshops by arrangement with no dates or prices, CDs and Bandcamp downloads; his YouTube channel has 495 subscribers and its latest upload is about three years old. With no current offerings and no way to confirm the published email (info@rickjarow.com) or base still apply, too thin to list. Could be revisited if his site comes back.
